description.value: Working Culture Bread is a family-run neighbourhood bakery and coffee shop in Victoria's Rock Bay area, open since 2020. They specialize in organic sourdough loaves made with just flour, water, and salt — using stone-milled BC whole grain flours — alongside rustic pastries and focaccia sandwiches. Their daily rotating bread menu and community-focused ethos make it a genuine local stop for cyclists looking for quality baked goods and a fresh coffee.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (4 spaces) at 7m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms this is a real, active bakery and café at 2506 Douglas Street, Victoria BC, with matching phone and address. The menu page confirms hot food (sandwiches, coffee, made-to-order breakfast sandwiches) and take-home bread loaves (basic groceries). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Contact page describes only car parking (3 reserved spaces in a nearby lot); no bike parking is mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags — bike parking status is unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active neighbourhood bakery and café confirmed open since 2020. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh bread, sandwiches, and coffee.

Hot food.detail: Sandwiches on fresh-baked sourdough focaccia (vegan, vegetarian, and meat options); made-to-order breakfast sandwiches on weekends; coffee served daily
